taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-07, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 2831.4 | 17.20 | 17.20
2 | 3567.9 | 2.07 | 19.27
3 | 3454.3 | 21.64 | 40.91
4 | 11701.4 | 4.12 | 45.03
5 | 140416.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as QHA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-07, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

Site Note: Station T-07, Survey Area T.

The interpreted subsurface profile consists of five layers. The sequence begins with 17.20m of 2831.4 ohm-m material, followed by a 2.07m layer at 3567.9 ohm-m, a 21.64m layer at 3454.3 ohm-m, and a 4.12m layer at 11701.4 ohm-m. The sequence is underlain by a high-resistivity basement of 140416.4 ohm-m.

Note: The interpretation on file classifies this station as a QHA-type curve. However, this is incorrect based on the provided resistivity values. The correct curve type is KHA, as the resistivity sequence (2831.4 < 3567.9 > 3454.3 < 11701.4 < 140416.4) follows the K (inverted V), H (V), and A (increasing) patterns respectively.

{"curve_type_stated": "QHA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
